verses: Shuroo kerta hun Allah Taalaa kay naam say jo bara meharban nihayat reham wala hai
Sab tareef Allah Taalaa kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka paalney wala hai
Bara meharban nihayat reham kerney wala
Badlay kay din (yani qayamat) ka malik hai
Hum sirf teri hi ibadat kertay hain aur sirf tujh hi say madad chahatay hain

Unn logon ki raah jin per tu ney inam kiya unn ki nahi jin per ghazab kiya gaya (yani woh log jinhon ney haq ko pehchana, magar uss per amal pera nahi huye) aur na gumrahon ki (yani woh log jo jahalat kay sabab raah haq say bar-gashta hogaye)
